description: Community-marked SponsorBlock segments of a YouTube video: sponsor reads, self-promotion, subscribe reminders, intros, outros, previews and filler, each with its [m:ss] range, a timestamp URL and how much of the transcript it covers (lines, word share and the first words). Use it to leave ad copy out of summaries and briefs: never cite text inside these segments as a claim about the topic. Default categories: sponsor, selfpromo, interaction, intro, outro, preview, filler. All: sponsor, selfpromo, interaction, intro, outro, preview, hook, filler, music_offtopic, poi_highlight, exclusive_access, chapter. poi_highlight comes back as `highlight` (a point, not a skip); a whole-video label comes back as `fullVideo`. Other platforms return no segments. Results carry the SponsorBlock attribution (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

categories.description: Categories to look up. Default: the env default or the seven above
